translations.ko: 마당도 오두막도 반짝반짝, 밥도 다 되어 있고, 밀 속엔 검은 알갱이가 하나도 없었습니다.
translations.tl: Kumikinang ang bakuran at kubo, luto na ang hapunan, at walang itim na butil sa trigo.

translations.en: "In the forest, I saw riders on a white horse, a red horse, and a black horse. Who are they?"

translations.en: "The white one is my morning, the red one my sun, the black one my night."

translations.zh-Hant: “白的是我的早晨，紅的是我的太陽，黑的是我的夜。”
translations.ko: "흰 것은 나의 아침, 빨간 것은 나의 해, 검은 것은 나의 밤이란다."
translations.tl: "Ang puti ay ang umaga ko, ang pula ang araw ko, ang itim ang gabi ko."
translations.ne: "सेतो मेरो बिहान, रातो मेरो घाम, कालो मेरो रात हो।"
translations.id: "Yang putih pagiku, yang merah matahariku, yang hitam malamku."
translations.pt: "O branco é minha manhã, o vermelho meu sol, o preto minha noite."
translations.my: "အဖြူက ငါ့မနက်၊ အနီက ငါ့နေ၊ အနက်က ငါ့ည ပေါ့။"

translations.id: Penunggang pagi dan siang lewat, dan saat malam tiba lagi, Vasilisa sampai di rumah.

translations.th: ชายยามเช้า ชายยามเที่ยงผ่านไป พอตกค่ำอีกครั้ง วาซิลิซาก็ถึงบ้าน

translations.vi: Người ta kể rằng suốt đời Vasilisa luôn giữ con búp bê nhỏ trong túi, nâng niu nó.
translations.en: And it is said Vasilisa kept that little doll in her pocket and treasured it all her life.
translations.zh-Hans: 据说，瓦西丽莎一辈子都把那个小娃娃放在口袋里，珍惜着它。
translations.zh-Hant: 據說，瓦西麗莎一輩子都把那個小娃娃放在口袋裡，珍惜著它。
translations.ko: 바실리사는 그 작은 인형을 평생 주머니에 넣고 소중히 했다고 합니다.
translations.tl: Sinasabing itinago ni Vasilisa ang maliit na manika sa bulsa at iningatan habambuhay.
translations.ne: भनिन्छ, भासिलिसाले त्यो सानो पुतली जीवनभर खल्तीमा राखेर माया गरिन्।
translations.id: Konon, Vasilisa menyimpan boneka kecil itu di saku dan menyayanginya seumur hidup.
translations.pt: Dizem que Vasilisa guardou a bonequinha no bolso e a estimou a vida toda.
translations.my: ဗာစီလီဆာက အဲဒီအရုပ်လေးကို တစ်သက်လုံး အိတ်ကပ်ထဲ ထည့်ပြီး မြတ်နိုးခဲ့တယ်လို့ ဆိုကြတယ်။
translations.th: ว่ากันว่า วาซิลิซาเก็บตุ๊กตาตัวน้อยไว้ในกระเป๋าและทะนุถนอมตลอดชีวิต
